visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black baseball cap, glasses, and a black t-shirt featuring movie posters stands in a room with shelves full of monster figurines. He gestures with his hand while holding a smartphone, looking directly at the camera with a cheerful expression. (2) Close-up view of a smartphone screen displaying a high battery percentage and active 5G icons. The man's thumb is visible on the side of the phone. The lighting is bright and indoor-focused. (3) The man points toward a display case filled with numerous Godzilla figurines and movie memorabilia. He smiles widely, showing his teeth, while wearing a Godzilla-themed black t-shirt. The background is slightly dark but the subjects are well-lit. (4) A montage sequence displays a variety of smartphone cases with diverse Godzilla illustrations—from retro movie posters to stylized cute character art. They are laid out on a flat surface with some figurines placed around them. (5) A humorous skit shows a person in a messy long-haired wig and a white fuzzy top. They exhibit a shocked facial expression and proceed to throw a phone toward the camera to test its impact resistance. (6) Close-up of a circular MagSafe phone stand with a Godzilla design being attached to the back of a phone. Additional tech accessories like iPad cases and AirPods covers with similar branding are showcased. (7) The original creator returns, pointing aggressively yet playfully at the camera while speaking. A final graphic overlay appears with a discount code and promotional text over the product images.
